import os
import sys
import time
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Set paths
input_dir = "./input"
sub_dir = "./submission"
train_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv")
test_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv")
sample_submission_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv")
submission_path = os.path.join(sub_dir, "submission.csv")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(sub_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)

print(f"Loaded training data: {len(train_df)} rows, {len(train_df.columns)} columns")
print(f"Loaded test data: {len(test_df)} rows, {len(test_df.columns)} columns")
print(f"Loaded sample submission: {len(sample_submission)} rows")

# Define feature columns - exclude id and target from features
features = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in ["id", "target"]]
cat_features = [c for c in features if train_df[c].dtype == "object"]
num_features = [c for c in features if c not in cat_features]

# Extract training and test features/targets
X_train = train_df[num_features + [f for f in cat_features]].copy()
y_train = train_df["target"].copy()
X_test = test_df[num_features + [f for f in cat_features]].copy()

# Check for null values in training data
missing_vals = X_train.isnull().sum().sum()
if missing_vals > 0:
    print(f"Found {missing_vals} null values in training data")
    X_train = X_train.fillna(0)
    X_test = X_test.fillna(0)

# Preprocess training data with categorical encoding
label_encoders = {}
for col in cat_features:
    if col in X_train.columns:
        encoder = LabelEncoder()
        encoder.fit(X_train[col].values)
        label_encoders[col] = encoder
        X_train[col] = encoder.transform(X_train[col].astype(str))

# Preprocess validation data
X_train_features, X_val_features, y_train_features, y_val_features = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train.values
)

# Apply same encoding to validation
for col in cat_features:
    if col in X_val_features.columns:
        X_val_features[col] = label_encoders[col].transform(
            X_val_features[col].astype(str)
        )

# Preprocess test data
for col in cat_features:
    if col in X_test.columns:
        X_test[col] = label_encoders[col].transform(X_test[col].astype(str))

# Combine numerical features
X_num_train = X_train_features[num_features]
X_num_val = X_val_features[num_features]
X_num_test = X_test[num_features]

# Convert numeric to float
for col in num_features:
    X_num_train[col] = X_num_train[col].astype(float)
    X_num_val[col] = X_num_val[col].astype(float)
    X_num_test[col] = X_num_test[col].astype(float)

# Combine all features
X_train_all = X_num_train
X_val_all = X_num_val
X_test_all = X_num_test

# Preprocess categorical features and combine
for col in cat_features:
    if col in X_train_all.columns:
        X_train_all = X_train_all.astype(float)
    elif col in X_val_all.columns:
        X_val_all = X_val_all.astype(float)
    elif col in X_test_all.columns:
        X_test_all = X_test_all.astype(float)
    X_train_all[f"{col}_cat"] = (
        label_encoders[col]
        .transform(X_train_all[col].astype(str))
        .astype(int)
        .values.flatten()
    )
    X_val_all[f"{col}_cat"] = (
        label_encoders[col]
        .transform(X_val_all[col].astype(str))
        .astype(int)
        .values.flatten()
    )
    X_test_all[f"{col}_cat"] = (
        label_encoders[col]
        .transform(X_test_all[col].astype(str))
        .astype(int)
        .values.flatten()
    )

# Rebuild combined dataframe for all features
X_train_combined = X_train_all.copy()
X_val_combined = X_val_all.copy()
X_test_combined = X_test_all.copy()

for col in cat_features:
    X_train_combined[col] = X_train_combined.pop(f"{col}_cat").values
    X_val_combined[col] = X_val_combined.pop(f"{col}_cat").values
    X_test_combined[col] = X_test_combined.pop(f"{col}_cat").values

# Convert to numpy arrays for training
X_train_arr = X_train_combined.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
X_val_arr = X_val_combined.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
X_test_arr = X_test_combined.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
y_train_arr = y_train_features.values

# Scale features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_arr)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val_arr)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_arr)

# Calculate scale_pos_weight for imbalanced data
scale_pos_weight = np.sum(y_train_arr == 0) / np.sum(y_train_arr == 1)
print(
    f"Class distribution - Positive ({np.sum(y_train_arr == 1)}), Negative ({np.sum(y_train_arr == 0)})"
)
print(f"Scale pos weight: {scale_pos_weight:.6f}")

# Initialize and train XGBoost model
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    min_child_weight=5,
    gamma=0.001,
    seed=42,
    scale_pos_weight=float(scale_pos_weight),
    random_state=42,
    verbosity=0,
)

# Train ONLY on training portion (NOT validation)
model.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train_arr)

# Get prediction probabilities for validation set
probabilities_valid = model.predict_proba(X_val_scaled)[:, 1]

# Compute genuine hold-out validation score (do not refit on validation data)
valid_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_features.values, probabilities_valid)

# Print the validation metric clearly
print(f"\nValidation AUC-ROC Score (on hold-out data): {valid_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set using the trained model
test_probabilities = model.predict_proba(X_test_scaled)[:, 1]

# Create submission DataFrame with correct format matching sample submission header
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"id": sample_submission["id"].values, "target": test_probabilities}
)

# Save the final submission file to required location
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to: {submission_path}")

# Verify submission was created successfully
assert os.path.exists(submission_path), "Submission file not created!"
print(f"Verification: {len(submission_df)} samples saved")
print(f"\nFinal Validation ROC-AUC: {valid_auc:.6f}")
